CFML Language Reference: Functions

StructKeyArray

Returns a one-dimensional array containing the names of all top-level keys of a structure.

Category

Structure functions

Syntax

StructKeyArray(structure)

Parameters

structure
The structure whose keys you want.

Returns

An array of key names, in uppercase.

Usage

The array is a new copy; changing it does not change the structure. Do not depend on the order of the keys. Sort the array with ArraySort if order matters. StructKeyList returns the same names as a list.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Fruit = StructNew()>
<CFSET Fruit.Pear = 3>
<CFSET Fruit.Apple = 7>
<CFSET Fruit.Kiwi = 1>
<CFSET Keys = StructKeyArray(Fruit)>
<CFSET Temp = ArraySort(Keys, "textnocase")>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<CFLOOP INDEX="i" FROM="1" TO="#ArrayLen(Keys)#">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>#Keys[i]#</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#Fruit[Keys[i]]#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>

See also

StructKeyList, ArraySort, StructCount
